# What does an escort run really make? True profit, margin and the lowest quote

> Free calculator for pilot car and oversize-load escort operators. Enter your quote (flat, day rate or per loaded mile), minimum charge, loaded and deadhead miles, driver hours, fuel, per diem and yearly overhead; it shows true profit per run, profit per driver hour and the lowest quote for your margin.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
